We're transforming healthcare. By pairing digital convenience with human expertise, we're placing the highest-quality healthcare into the hands of millions.
We are Europe’s largest digital clinic.
We combine gold-standard clinical expertise with smart technology

In 2019, we had seen enough. Enough waiting rooms. Enough referrals lost in handoffs. Enough capable clinicians buried under admin. The problem wasn't a lack of technology — health systems across the UK and Europe were swimming in it. The problem was that none of it was built around the people actually giving and receiving care.
So they started from scratch. Not with a product looking for a problem, but with a question: what does it look like when nothing gets in the way? And this is what it looks like.

Skyrocketing demand, limited clinical capacity and tight budgets have put a real squeeze on healthcare. It's frustrating for patients and tough on providers. We're here to change that. By using the latest digital tools we're joining up a fragmented ecosystem to move the entire health sector forward.

We are extremely proud to deliver the highest quality of care to patients, being the only player in the market—among all digital and traditional healthcare players—to have received two consecutive “Outstanding” CQC ratings. With a network of 3,000 clinicians, HealthHero infuses clinical expertise at every layer of the business: from supporting patients, to advising platform development, setting high-quality standards, and ensuring robust clinical governance. Our relentless focus on care quality and governance has earned us a strong reputation, allowing us to attract the best clinicians in the market.
